definitions.explanation: One of the ten standard cloud genera: a flat, featureless, low-altitude cloud sheet that covers large areas of sky, often producing drizzle or mist. Distinguished from cumulus by its uniform layered appearance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{層雲|そううん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかっている→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: Stratus clouds are hanging over the mountain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧{層雲|そううん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|おお}っていた→覆う：02020_oou⟧。
examples.english: In the morning, low stratus clouds covered the town.

examples.japanese: {層雲|そううん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{霧雨|きりさめ}→霧雨：07684_kirisame⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{降|ふ}らせる→降る：00839_furu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

{層雲|そううん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧で、⟦{地表|ちひょう}→地表：18419_chihyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接|せっ}する→接する：12920_sessuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: Stratus is the lowest-altitude cloud type, and when it touches the ground it is called fog.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧ (layer) and {雲|うん} (cloud). One of the ten standard cloud classifications (⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧{雲形|うんけい}) used in meteorology.

USAGE:
- A meteorological term used in weather reports, textbooks, and sometimes in everyday descriptions of overcast conditions.
- Used as a plain noun; does not take ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧{層雲|そううん}: low stratus
- {層雲|そううん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: stratus hangs (over an area)
- {層雲|そううん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: stratus clouds spread out

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{積雲|せきうん}→積雲：23702_sekiun⟧: cumulus — puffy, vertically developed clouds
- ⟦{高層雲|こうそううん}→高層雲：26208_kousouun⟧: altostratus — stratus clouds at middle altitude
- {乱層雲|らんそううん}: nimbostratus — thick stratus producing steady rain
- ⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧: fog — ground-level stratus
